label: Art Movement
description: Historical art movements as style directives — characteristics, never artist names.

items.name: impressionism
items.text: impressionist rendering, broken color dabs, fleeting light over precise form

items.name: expressionism
items.text: expressionist rendering, distorted forms and raw color carrying emotion over accuracy

items.name: art-nouveau
items.text: art-nouveau styling, whiplash organic curves, ornamental florals and elegant flat framing

items.name: art-deco
items.text: art-deco styling, stepped geometry, gilded fans and machine-age symmetry

items.name: ukiyo-e
items.text: ukiyo-e woodblock styling, flat color planes, bold outlines and stylized waves

items.name: surrealism
items.text: surrealist composition, dream-logic juxtapositions rendered with realistic precision

items.name: cubism
items.text: cubist rendering, the subject fractured into simultaneous geometric viewpoints

items.name: bauhaus
items.text: bauhaus design language, primary colors, elemental shapes, form strictly following function

items.name: de-stijl
items.text: de-stijl abstraction, black grids with primary color planes

items.name: romanticism
items.text: romanticist grandeur, sublime nature overwhelming small human figures

items.name: baroque
items.text: baroque drama, sweeping diagonals, rich fabrics and theatrical divine light

items.name: minimalism
items.text: minimalist reduction, few elements, exact placement, maximal restraint

items.name: pop-art
items.text: pop-art treatment, flat commercial color, halftone dots and bold outlines

items.name: brutalism
items.text: brutalist aesthetic, raw monolithic concrete masses and unapologetic weight

items.name: abstract-expressionism
items.text: abstract-expressionist energy, gestural sweeps and dripped texture at mural scale
